# data/ — sourced inputs, with provenance

Raw inputs only. Nothing in this folder is calculated. Every file gets a row below.

| File | What it is | Source | Pulled | Notes |
|------|------------|--------|--------|-------|
| `prep-batch-costs.csv` | Variable cost (ingredients + labor) for each successive 20-plate batch | *Illustrative.* Fictional owner interview, 2026-10-03 | 2026-10-03 | Batches 6+ include overtime and a second cook, so the cost per batch rises |

Model inputs that aren't in a file:

| Input | Value | Source |
|-------|-------|--------|
| Price per plate | $14.00 | *Illustrative.* Posted menu price |
| Daily fixed cost | $300 | *Illustrative.* Permit, parking, and truck lease ÷ operating days |

> In a real engagement, "Source" is a link or a citation someone else can check, not "illustrative."
